visual.name: AtlynHierarchyExplorer
visual.description: Explore parent-child hierarchies with an accessible tree, search, expand and collapse, breadcrumbs, and diagnostics that surface orphans, cycles, and duplicate IDs instead of hiding them.

en-US.UI_NoData: Add NodeId, ParentId, and Label fields to explore a hierarchy.
en-US.UI_MatrixUnsupported: Matrix mode is not enabled. Use the table NodeId, ParentId, and Label roles.
en-US.UI_RenderCap: The visible hierarchy is capped for responsiveness; collapse or search to reach additional nodes.
en-US.Diagnostic_invalid-cardinality: The field mapping exceeds the supported cardinality.
en-US.Diagnostic_invalid-data-shape: The table contains an unsupported or malformed data shape.
en-US.Diagnostic_empty-id: Rows with an empty NodeId were excluded.
en-US.Diagnostic_empty-label: Nodes with an empty Label use an accessible fallback label.
en-US.Diagnostic_duplicate-id: Duplicate NodeId values were received; the first table row is retained.
en-US.Diagnostic_conflicting-duplicate: Conflicting duplicate NodeId rows are never selectable; the first table row is retained.
en-US.Diagnostic_orphan: Nodes whose ParentId is missing are rendered as disconnected roots.
en-US.Diagnostic_self-cycle: Self-referencing parent links were broken and rendered as roots.
en-US.Diagnostic_cycle: Long parent cycles were broken at a deterministic node and retained.
en-US.Diagnostic_multiple-roots: Multiple roots form a valid forest and are rendered side-by-side.
en-US.Diagnostic_data-reduction: The table is rendered under the bounded contract.
en-US.Diagnostic_node-cap: The node cap excluded additional nodes.
en-US.Diagnostic_partial-data: Only the currently received table segment is rendered; additional rows may still be loading.
